flags.detail: The output claims the Bruins game is 'Saturday' when the TODAY date is 2026-10-31 (a Friday) and the schedule lists the game for 2026-10-31.
The output incorrectly identifies the Celtics game as occurring on 'Friday night' when the source data confirms it was played on 2026-10-30, which was a Thursday.
repetition: formulaic paragraph opener "looking ahead to ..." recurs in today's output and 1 of the last 3 day(s) (threshold: 2 consecutive days)

The output claims the Bruins game is 'today' (Saturday, 2026-10-31) while the UPCOMING_SCHEDULE lists the game as Saturday, 2026-10-31, but the TODAY date is 2026-10-31, and the text refers to it as 'today' while the schedule confirms it is indeed today, however, the text also refers to the game as a 'Saturday afternoon' matinee, which is correct, but the prompt's TODAY is 2026-10-31, which is a Friday, not a Saturday.
The output claims the Bruins game is 'this afternoon' on Friday, 2026-10-31, but the UPCOMING_SCHEDULE lists the game for Saturday, 2026-10-31.
